notes.title: +18 Patch Instructions!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Have you tried Lovely Heroines yet? 

Did you know that it features a FREE +18 patch? (contains adult content and themes)

You must download it and apply it manually, so here are the instructions!

1. Purchase the Game on Steam
2. Download -> Run -> close
3. Download the free DLC +18patch Mod.
4. Unpack the Mod, replace the folder data (root) and the folder pictures (resources\Graphics)
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Lovely Heroines\game
5. Start Lovely Heroines and enjoy the Full+18 version.

If you run into any troubles or have questions, contact us and we'll gladly help!

Now go save New Dork City!
